items.title: Smart home devices should work without the internet
items.summary: The author lays out the rules they've followed over ten years of home automation, starting with rule one: nothing in the house should depend on a vendor's server to function. The writeup pairs the principles with both of the talks they've given on the topic, going slide by slide.

items.title: .name Grandfathered
items.summary: After a long battle, Verisign is retracting its plan to terminate 22,000 third-level .name domains and email redirects. Existing domains will remain indefinitely, though new third-level registrations are closing. Neil Fraser credits a team effort including reconsideration requests, legal pressure on ICANN, and letters of support.

items.title: Scion is back and is going to sell a kei truck in America
items.summary: Toyota is reviving Scion as "Scion by Toyota," a "freedom lab" for mobility concepts, and its first production vehicle is the KEI-01, a rebadged Daihatsu Hijet kei truck built for the US market. It has a 660cc engine, 600-pound payload, 4WD, and low-speed vehicle certification limiting it to under 25 mph, so it's aimed at fleet, farm, and urban work rather than daily driving. Availability starts in late 2027 as a low-volume fleet pilot.
